mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_operation_work (job_name, run_id, id, name, email, status, updated_at, version) SELECT #{scope.run.job}, #{scope.run.runId}, c.id, c.name, c.email, c.status, c.updated_at, c.version FROM customer c WHERE ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO batch_operation_work (job_name, run_id, id, name, email, status, updated_at, version, detail) SELECT #{scope.run.job}, #{scope.run.runId}, c.id, c.name, c.email, c.status, c.updated_at, c.version, 'customer-' || c.id || '@example.invalid' FROM customer c WHERE AND c.email IS DISTINCT FROM ('customer-' || c.id || '@example.invalid') AND (c.email IS NULL OR c.email = '') ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: WITH changed AS ( UPDATE customer c SET status = w.detail, version = c.version + 1, updated_at = statement_timestamp() FROM batch_operation_work w WHERE w.job_name = #{run.job} AND w.run_id = #{run.runId} AND NOT w.applied AND c.id = w.id AND c.version = w.version AND c.status = w.status RETURNING c.id ), recorded AS ( UPDATE batch_operation_work w SET applied = true FROM changed WHERE w.job_name = #{run.job} AND w.run_id = #{run.runId} AND w.id = changed.id RETURNING w.id ) SELECT count(*) FROM recorded

WITH changed AS ( UPDATE customer c SET email = w.detail, version = c.version + 1, updated_at = statement_timestamp() FROM batch_operation_work w WHERE w.job_name = #{run.job} AND w.run_id = #{run.runId} AND NOT w.applied AND c.id = w.id AND c.version = w.version AND c.email IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.email RETURNING c.id ), recorded AS ( UPDATE batch_operation_work w SET applied = true FROM changed WHERE w.job_name = #{run.job} AND w.run_id = #{run.runId} AND w.id = changed.id RETURNING w.id ) SELECT count(*) FROM recorded
SELECT count(*) FROM batch_operation_work WHERE job_name = #{job} AND run_id = #{runId} AND applied

SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT c.id FROM batch_operation_work w JOIN customer c ON c.id = w.id WHERE w.job_name = #{job} AND w.run_id = #{runId} AND NOT w.applied ORDER BY c.id FOR UPDATE OF c ) AS locked
SELECT count(*) FROM batch_operation_work w JOIN membership m ON m.customer_id = w.id WHERE w.job_name = #{job} AND w.run_id = #{runId} AND NOT w.applied
SELECT count(*) FROM batch_operation_work WHERE job_name = #{job} AND run_id = #{runId}
SELECT count(*) FROM batch_operation_work WHERE job_name = #{run.job} AND run_id = #{run.runId} AND detail = #{kind}
SELECT 1::bigint FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('operation-aggregation-' || #{period})::bigint)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM batch_customer_totals WHERE period = #{period} AND bucket_date >= #{from} AND bucket_date < #{to}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_customer_totals (period, bucket_date, status, customer_count) SELECT #{period}, date_trunc(#{period}, updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, status, count(*) FROM customer WHERE updated_at >= (CAST(#{from} AS date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND updated_at < (CAST(#{to} AS date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') GROUP BY 2, 3
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM batch_input_work WHERE job_name = #{job} AND run_id = #{runId}
SELECT count(*) FROM batch_input WHERE job_name = #{job} AND run_id = #{runId}
SELECT count(*) FROM batch_input_error WHERE job_name = #{job} AND run_id = #{runId}
SELECT coalesce(sum(row_count), 0)::bigint FROM batch_input_check WHERE job_name = #{job} AND run_id = #{runId}

WITH deleted AS ( DELETE FROM customer c USING batch_operation_work w WHERE w.job_name = #{run.job} AND w.run_id = #{run.runId} AND NOT w.applied AND c.id = w.id AND c.version = w.version AND c.status = w.status AND c.email IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.email AND c.name = w.name AND c.updated_at = w.updated_at AND w.detail = 'MISSING' RETURNING c.id ), recorded AS ( UPDATE batch_operation_work w SET applied = true FROM deleted WHERE w.job_name = #{run.job} AND w.run_id = #{run.runId} AND w.id = deleted.id RETURNING w.id ) SELECT count(*) FROM recorded
mapper.insert: WITH input AS ( SELECT customer_id, name, email, status FROM batch_input_work WHERE job_name = #{scope.run.job} AND run_id = #{scope.run.runId} ) INSERT INTO batch_operation_work (job_name, run_id, id, name, email, status, updated_at, version, detail) SELECT #{scope.run.job}, #{scope.run.runId}, coalesce(i.customer_id, c.id), CASE WHEN i.customer_id IS NULL THEN c.name ELSE i.name END, CASE WHEN i.customer_id IS NULL THEN c.email ELSE i.email END, CASE WHEN i.customer_id IS NULL THEN c.status ELSE i.status END, coalesce(c.updated_at, transaction_timestamp()), coalesce(c.version, 0), CASE WHEN i.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 'NEW' ELSE 'CHANGED' END FROM input i FULL JOIN customer c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE i.customer_id IS NULL OR c.id IS NULL OR (i.name, i.email, i.status) IS DISTINCT FROM (c.name, c.email, c.status) ORDER BY 3 LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO customer (id, name, email, status, version) SELECT id, name, email, status, 1 FROM batch_operation_work WHERE job_name = #{job} AND run_id = #{runId} AND detail = 'NEW' ORDER BY id ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE customer c SET name = w.name, email = w.email, status = w.status, version = c.version + 1, updated_at = statement_timestamp() FROM batch_operation_work w WHERE w.job_name = #{job} AND w.run_id = #{runId} AND w.detail = 'CHANGED' AND c.id = w.id AND c.version = w.version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_patch_plan (plan_id, patch_id, preview_run, definition, expected_rows, state) VALUES (#{request.planId}, #{request.patchId}, #{request.scope.run.runId}, #{request.definition}, 0, 'PREVIEWED') ON CONFLICT (plan_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_patch_plan SET expected_rows = #{count} WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT patch_id, plan_id, state, definition, expected_rows, preview_run, apply_run, restore_run, mode FROM batch_patch_plan WHERE plan_id = #{planId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_patch_claim (patch_id, plan_id) VALUES (#{patchId}, #{planId}) ON CONFLICT (patch_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_patch_plan SET state = 'APPLYING', apply_run = #{runId}, mode = #{mode} WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND state = 'PREVIEWED'
UPDATE batch_patch_plan SET state = 'RESTORING', restore_run = #{runId}, mode = #{mode} WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND state = 'APPLIED'
mapper.select: WITH changed AS ( UPDATE customer c SET status = w.new_status, version = c.version + 1, updated_at = statement_timestamp() FROM batch_patch_row w WHERE w.plan_id = #{planId} AND w.applied_version IS NULL AND c.id = w.id AND c.version = w.old_version AND c.status = w.old_status RETURNING c.id, c.version, c.status ), recorded AS ( UPDATE batch_patch_row w SET applied_version = changed.version FROM changed WHERE w.plan_id = #{planId} AND w.id = changed.id AND changed.status = w.new_status AND changed.version = w.old_version + 1 RETURNING w.id ) SELECT count(*) FROM recorded

WITH changed AS ( UPDATE customer c SET status = w.old_status, version = c.version + 1, updated_at = statement_timestamp() FROM batch_patch_row w WHERE w.plan_id = #{planId} AND w.restored_version IS NULL AND c.id = w.id AND c.version = w.applied_version AND c.status = w.new_status RETURNING c.id, c.version, c.status ), recorded AS ( UPDATE batch_patch_row w SET restored_version = changed.version FROM changed WHERE w.plan_id = #{planId} AND w.id = changed.id AND changed.status = w.old_status AND changed.version = w.applied_version + 1 RETURNING w.id ) SELECT count(*) FROM recorded
